info.title: Flame in Freefall API
info.summary: Frontend-facing REST contract for the Flame in Freefall scientific dashboard.
info.description:
Contract-first specification (MVP plan §12, DAY2_TASKS Lead deliverable). The FastAPI implementation is in `apps/api` and serves this document at `/api/openapi.json`; `x-implementation-status` records implementation state. API bearer authentication is required: use a key with the read scope for GET/HEAD, the write scope for other mutations and the admin scope for `/api/admin/*`. AURA Track AP compatibility is checked from this contract against a pinned AURA revision by `tests/integration/aura_blueprint_dryrun.py`.

Conventions: snake_case JSON; RFC 3339 UTC timestamps; ULID resource IDs; nullable means 'not present or not established' (never 0 for missing); every JSON success body has `meta`; every error body is `ErrorResponse`.

Scientific rules encoded in the schema: no temperature field exists; pixel measurements are `measured`, scale-derived physical sizes are `estimated`; AI interpretation is separate from measurements and limited to inferred/hypothesized/unsupported claim classes; evidence is only source content or deterministic calculation.

AURA boundary (ADR-004, contract 0.2.0): operations marked `x-aura-exclude: true` (chat, AI status, admin writes) are skipped by AURA's OpenAPI discovery, so AURA can never compile a tool that calls back into Flame's model path. Changes: docs/api/CHANGELOG.md.

Credentials and rate limits (P2-1, P2-2): each caller has its own API key (`python -m flame_api.clients create NAME --scopes read|write|admin [--owner PERSON]`), stored hashed and revocable. `read` scope allows GET/HEAD and `POST /api/chat`; `write` scope allows every other method outside `/api/admin/`; `admin` scope (ADR-009 step 2, contract 0.6.0) allows every `/api/admin/` operation, reads included, and an admin key always names the person who holds it. Scopes are independent: `admin` implies neither `read` nor `write`. A valid key without the needed scope gets 403 `FORBIDDEN`; while the database is unreachable a client key cannot be checked and gets 503 `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`. The legacy `FLAME_READ_API_TOKEN` / `FLAME_WRITE_API_TOKEN` are deprecated but still accepted with their old meaning, so the write token still reaches `/api/admin/` (a token used for the wrong kind of request stays 401). Every authenticated `/api/*` operation except `/api/health` is rate-limited per client, with separate per-minute budgets for reads, writes and chat (chat is the strictest); over the budget the response is 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After` in seconds. One client exhausting its budget does not affect another's.

post.description: Validates the upload synchronously (size, type by content, decode, dimensions), stores the original immutably, and enqueues the CV job. Always asynchronous: returns 202 with the Analysis in status `queued`; poll GET /api/analyses/{analysis_id}. Videos (0.3.0) are probed synchronously (container, codec, fps, duration) and analysed on sampled frames by the local video provider; poll the same way.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running analysis
post.description: Write scope (ADR-008). A queued analysis becomes `cancelled` at once (200). A processing one records `cancel_requested_at` and stays `processing` until the worker stops (202): a video job checks at every checkpoint segment, an image job before storing its result. A cancelled analysis keeps no result, and its video checkpoint is deleted. `failure.code` is `CANCELLED`. Excluded from AURA (`x-aura-exclude`): AURA never changes a user's jobs.

200.description: The analysis was queued and is now `cancelled`, or it was already cancelled (cancelling is idempotent).

202.description: The job is running: the cancel request is recorded (`cancel_requested_at`) and status stays `processing` until the worker stops, at its next checkpoint for a video and before storing its result for an image. Poll GET until it is `cancelled`.

409.description: The analysis already reached `completed` or `failed`; a finished analysis is immutable. Codes: ANALYSIS_NOT_CANCELLABLE.

value.ranking_method: relevance = 0.35*oxygen_match + 0.25*pressure_match + 0.25*evidence_density + 0.15*outcome_data; oxygen_match = 1 inside the tested O2 range else exp(-gap/0.05); pressure_match = 1 inside the tested pressure range else exp(-|ln(P/P_nearest)|/0.25); evidence_density = min(1, ln(1+n)/ln(31)) for n tests within +/-0.03 O2 (and +/-25% pressure when recorded); outcome_data = 1 end state recorded, 0.5 duration only, 0 none; unrecorded variables score 0 and are listed in 'not_recorded'.

coverage.headline: 20 of the 1950 flight tests lie near this atmosphere.
coverage.method: verdict = 'none' when the scenario's gravity was never flown or no flight test lies within +/-0.03 O2 (and +/-25% pressure when recorded) of it; 'partial' when 1-4 such tests exist or the atmosphere is outside the flown O2 or pressure range or fewer than 5 of those tests record a pressure within +/-25% (a test with no recorded pressure cannot show the scenario's pressure was flown); otherwise 'covered'. nearest_test minimises sqrt((dO2/0.05)^2 + (ln(P/P_test)/0.25)^2), the scales of the relevance score.

items.title: Flame Extinguishment Experiment
items.hardware: Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR)-Fluids and Combustion Facility (FCF), Multi-user Droplet Combustion Appartatus (MDCA)

objective.text: The FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment) investigation aims to map the flammability limits of liquid fuels in microgravity environments, measure the effectiveness of various gaseous fire suppressants such as CO2, He, and SF6, and develop reliable predictive models for combustion limits under reduced gravity conditions. The mission seeks to validate and improve simplified models by incorporating detailed chemical reactions, heat transfer, and material movement, using both space-based data and extensive ground-based tests. Key flight experiment goals include obtaining high-resolution measurements of droplet burning rates, flame extinction behavior, heat radiation, soot levels, and temperature profiles, while systematically analyzing the effects of different ambient conditions and suppressant concentrations. These investigations are essential for advancing the fundamental understanding of combustion processes in microgravity and enhancing fire safety protocols for future space missions.

get.description: Probability that a FLEX-like droplet flame self-extinguishes, ends by disruption or burns to completion, from pre-ignition conditions. The probabilities are calibrated (prior correction of the class-balanced classifier, since model 1.1.0); `model.calibration` gives their grouped-CV calibration error and the uncalibrated one. Strict applicability domain: outside the flight-tested ranges, `probabilities` is null with reasons. Always returns the nearest real flight tests and their recorded end state as evidence. Evaluation: docs/evaluation/reports/flex-outcome-model.md.

live.summary: Real response over the committed PSI tables (API test client, 2026-11-14); lists trimmed.

primary_estimate.method: 5x repeated 5-fold CV grouped by test day, all usable rows

model.holdout_note: v1.1 (2026-11-14, KB audit): the API showed the raw extinction probability as a 'chance', but the balanced class weighting makes it under-confident (hold-out bin 0.2-0.4: observed 0.50). Probabilities are now prior-corrected. This was added after the hold-out calibration was viewed; it fits no parameters beyond the training class frequencies, and the repeated grouped CV over all rows (calibration section) is the primary evidence. The most likely class now follows the calibrated probabilities, so its macro-F1 is lower.

scenario.name: Apollo 1: pure-O₂ ground test (1967)
scenario.note: Plugs-out test on the launch pad, 27 January 1967: 100% oxygen at 16.7 psia (115.1 kPa), at 1 g. Historical atmosphere; no crewed vehicle uses it today.
scenario.citation: Report of Apollo 204 Review Board, NASA-TM-108667 (FF-NTRS-19930078717), p. 189

value.story: During a ground test the Apollo 204 command module was filled with 100% oxygen at 16.7 psia. An electrical arc was the most probable ignition source. The fire spread through combustible materials, pressure rose until the cabin ruptured, and the inner hatch could not be opened against the internal pressure. Command Pilot Virgil I. Grissom, Senior Pilot Edward H. White II and Pilot Roger B. Chaffee died.
value.lesson: None of our flight tests comes near this atmosphere, so the system does not guess. In 1967 the cabin materials were exposed to a 100% oxygen atmosphere in which they had never been tested; the Review Board called the test conditions extremely hazardous.

lesson_sources.quote: the state-of-the-art materials were exposed to 16.2 psia 100% oxygen environment in which they had never been tested
The test was conducted with a 16.7 pounds per square inch absolute, 100 percent oxygen atmosphere. DETERMINATION: The test conditions were extremely hazardous.

timeline.title: Pure-oxygen cabins
timeline.text: Mercury, Gemini and Apollo were all designed for a 100% oxygen environment; in flight the cabin ran at about 34.5 kPa (5 psia).

sources.title: Technology Development for Fire Safety in Exploration Spacecraft and Habitats

timeline.title: The plugs-out test
timeline.text: On the pad the cabin held 100% oxygen at 16.7 psia, above sea-level pressure. The Board found many combustible materials next to possible ignition sources; the most probable initiator was an electrical arc.

scenario.name: Orion crew vehicle (max O₂)
scenario.note: Orion maximum 30% O₂; total pressure from the normoxic curve (ppO₂ 3.09 psia).

alternative.headline: Where flight data does exist: NASA's exploration atmosphere
alternative.rationale: Orion's design limit, 30% O₂ on the normoxic curve (about 10.3 psia), sits inside the FLEX flight envelope, so the system can show measured flight tests and an estimate there. Covered by data does not mean safe: 30% oxygen is more flammable than air.

sources.title: Microgravity Flame Spread in Exploration Atmospheres: Pressure, Oxygen, and Velocity Effects on Opposed and Concurrent Flame Spread

get.summary: Suppression Advisor: CO₂ or water-mist extinguisher
get.description: Deterministic recommendation between the ISS CO₂ PFE and Fine Water Mist PFE for a cabin (no language model). Computes the post-discharge fire-zone and cabin atmospheres, crew hazards (a CO₂ discharge reaching the CO₂ IDLH vetoes CO₂), the crossover delivery fraction η*, and, for FLEX fuels, the FLEX outcome estimate for CO₂ with the nearest flight tests. An absolute water-mist probability is returned only when the thermal model passed both D2 gates (it currently fails the MIST check, so it is withheld). Plan: docs/plan/SUPPRESSION_ADVISOR_PLAN.md; ADR-014.

parameters.name: fire_type
parameters.description: What is burning. Only heptane and methanol get probabilities; other_liquid gets the relative comparison; electrical_battery a sourced rule; solid hazards and evidence only (D4).

parameters.name: cabin_volume_m3
parameters.description: Free volume of the module. The default is an example value, not a fact; the ISS airlock is 31 m³ nominal.

parameters.name: pressure_kpa
parameters.description: Cabin total pressure before the discharge.

parameters.name: o2_fraction
parameters.description: Cabin O₂ mole fraction.

parameters.name: co2_fraction
parameters.description: Cabin CO₂ mole fraction before the discharge.

parameters.name: temperature_k
parameters.description: Cabin gas temperature.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: well_mixed: the discharge fills the whole cabin (conservative). local: it fills local_zone_fraction of the cabin.

parameters.name: local_zone_fraction
parameters.description: Assumption: the share of the cabin an aimed discharge fills. Used only with zone=local.

parameters.name: delivery_fraction
parameters.description: Assumption η: the share of the water that reaches the fire as fine mist.

parameters.name: droplet_diameter_mm
parameters.description: FLEX droplet diameter for the CO₂ flight-data estimate.

default_cabin.summary: 100 m³ cabin, heptane, well mixed (no FLEX rows attached)

assumptions.cabin_volume_m3: example value unless you enter your module's free volume (sourced preset: ISS airlock 31 m³)
assumptions.zone: well-mixed is the conservative floor; local assumes the discharge fills 10% of the cabin
assumptions.delivery_fraction: η, the share of the water reaching the fire as fine mist: an assumption
assumptions.ventilation: off, per the ISS fire response

why: Neither extinguisher is ruled out on crew safety, and an absolute comparison is not supported here.
Water mist removes more heat if at least 23% of it reaches the fire; your assumed delivery is 50%.
what_would_change_it: How much of the mist reaches the fire: above 23% water mist removes more heat than CO₂.
A smaller cabin raises the CO₂ concentration the crew breathes after a CO₂ discharge.

crossover_delivery_fraction.statement: Water mist removes more heat than CO₂ here if at least 23% of it reaches the fire.
crossover_delivery_fraction.basis: effective enthalpy per mol O₂ (298→1600 K), fuel-independent approximation

hazards.statement: Cabin ppCO₂ 11.4 mmHg is above the NASA-STD-3001 one-hour average limit (3 mmHg) but below the IDLH.
hazards.assumption: IDLH applied as a partial pressure (0.04 × 760 mmHg)

hazards.statement: O₂ partial pressure after the discharge (dilution only; no sourced limit held).
Cabin pressure after the discharge, ventilation off.
ISS emergency breathing equipment does not filter CO₂ or supply oxygen; after a CO₂ PFE discharge the crew must wear a breathing apparatus that supplies oxygen.

charge.source: NTRS 20130011664 (Development of the ISS Fine Water Mist PFE)

hazards.statement: Cabin ppCO₂ 0.0 mmHg is within the NASA-STD-3001 one-hour average limit.
hazards.assumption: IDLH applied as a partial pressure (0.04 × 760 mmHg)

hazards.statement: O₂ partial pressure after the discharge (dilution only; no sourced limit held).
Cabin pressure after the discharge, ventilation off.
In microgravity undelivered mist does not settle; it stays airborne and collects on surfaces and equipment.
sources: NIST R0401173 (mist remained suspended for minutes in microgravity)

hazards.statement: Water reaching powered electronics is a hazard; NIST notes deionized water may be used for electrical fires. Remove power first per the fire response procedure.

withheld: Absolute water-mist probability withheld: the thermal model failed the MIST check (it over-predicts water-mist suppression of the MIST flames).

flex_auc.rule: mean − 1 SD of repeated grouped-CV ROC-AUC

mist.rule: model ω_w at P=0.5 must be ≥ 0.048 (highest measured extinguishing loading)
mist.note: MIST burned premixed propane–air at 1 atm in a 6.3 cm tube; heptane is used as the hydrocarbon proxy.

evidence.title: FLEX droplet extinction flight tests (CO₂ and He diluent)
ISS Fine Water Mist PFE development and fire tests
CO₂, N₂ and He as suppressants in microgravity; ISS CO₂ PFE

value.scope: Built from FLEX droplet-flame flight tests (heptane, methanol), the MIST water-mist flight experiment, ISS extinguisher test papers and published exposure limits. Water-mist suppression is computed, not flight-validated at cabin scale.
value.disclaimer: Decision support only. It does not replace flight rules or the emergency procedure: when in doubt, follow the flight rule.

request_id.description: Correlation ID for this request. Echoes the caller's `X-Request-ID` when supplied, otherwise server-generated. Also returned in the `X-Request-ID` response header.

generated_at.description: Server time (UTC) at which the response was produced.

api_version.description: Semantic version of this API contract.

ResponseMeta.description: Present on every successful JSON response (MVP plan §12: request_id, server timestamp, API version).

page_size.description: Items per page that was applied.

total_items.description: Total matching items across all pages.

total_pages.description: ceil(total_items / page_size); 0 when there are no items.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code. The frontend switches on this, never on `message`. AURA_UNAVAILABLE is deprecated since 0.2.0: chat now degrades to an evidence-only answer instead.

field.description: Request field, query parameter or form part that failed validation, e.g. `page_size` or `image`.

resource_id.description: ID that was not found or was in the wrong state.

retry_after_s.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, for RATE_LIMITED / *_UNAVAILABLE. Mirrors the `Retry-After` header.

ErrorDetails.description: Typed, optional context. Never contains stack traces, SQL, hostnames or secrets.

request_id.description: Same value as the `X-Request-ID` response header.

retryable.description: True when the identical request may succeed later (429, 503).

field_errors.description: Per-field validation failures; empty for non-validation errors.

ErrorResponse.description: The single error envelope used by every endpoint for every non-2xx status (RFC 7807-style fields per MVP plan §12, wrapped under `error`).

Repository.description: Canonical repository family. Identical to `repository` in datasets/registry/source_registry.schema.json.

title.description: Canonical source title from the registry.

persistent_identifier.description: DOI or other durable identifier, verbatim from the registry.

license.description: License as recorded in the registry, e.g. CC0-1.0.

access_url.description: Human-facing canonical landing page of the source.

SourceRef.description: Projection of one row of datasets/registry/source_registry.csv.

file_id.description: File identifier as recorded in datasets/metadata/files.jsonl (`sha256:` + first 16 hex chars).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

canonical_source_url.description: Where the original was fetched from (s3:// or PSI API URL).

is_original.description: True for an immutable upstream original; false for a derived artefact.

parent_file_id.description: file_id of the original this artefact was derived from.

FileRef.description: Projection of one record of datasets/metadata/files.jsonl.

LocatorType.description: What kind of position `Locator` points at (data dictionary: location_type).

page.description: 1-based physical page number in the original file.

row.description: 1-based data row in a tabular original (header excluded).

frame_index.description: 0-based frame index in an image sequence or video.

label.description: Human-readable rendering of the locator, e.g. `p. 5` or `row 12`.

Locator.description: A resolvable position inside an original artefact (data dictionary: location_pointer).

TextSpan.description: Half-open [start, end) UTF-16 code-unit offsets into `snippet`, for highlighting matched terms.

OverallStatus.description: healthy: every service up. degraded: a required service degraded or an optional one down/degraded. unhealthy: a required service down.

ServiceStatus.description: disabled: intentionally not configured in this deployment (e.g. AURA in the MVP). unknown: the probe has not run or timed out.

required.description: True if this service being down makes the overall status `unhealthy`.

latency_ms.description: Probe round-trip time. Null when the probe did not complete.

version.description: Safe version identifier (e.g. pipeline version, model name@version, Postgres major).

message.description: Safe one-line explanation when not `up`. Never contains hosts, DSNs or credentials.

vector_index.description: pgvector extension + active chunk index (ADR-002 planned: pgvector before a dedicated vector DB). Same server as `database`, reported separately because it can be absent while Postgres is up.

object_storage.description: S3-compatible store (MinIO locally) for uploads, masks, overlays.

cache.description: Redis (CAG, rate limits, job queue). Optional: failures degrade to recomputation.

llm.description: Flame's own model router (Ollama/vLLM) used for grounded answers.

HealthServices.description: Fixed set of service keys so the frontend can render a stable status grid.

git_sha.description: Commit the running API was built from.

knowledge_version.description: Published corpus/knowledge version. Null until the first index publication.

documents.description: Published `document` records (parsed NASA/NIST documents). Not raw files: files.jsonl has 121 file records, most of which are data/media, not documents.

experiments.description: `experiment` records (one per test, e.g. a BASS-II test ID) that have at least one ExperimentCondition.

chunks.description: All `document_chunk` rows (searchable passages), embedded or not.

indexed_chunks.description: Chunks with a vector in the published vector index (`chunk_embedding` rows of the model named by `vector_index_manifest`). 0 only when no index is published (no manifest row, or not PostgreSQL). Fewer than `chunks` means the index is stale and search runs lexical-only.

knowledge_version.description: Corpus version the document count refers to.

DashboardCountsResponse.description: All counts are exact `COUNT(*)` reads at `meta.generated_at`. On failure the endpoint returns 503, never zeros.

SearchResultType.description: document: a matched passage inside a parsed document (carries a page/section locator). experiment: a matched experiment/test record.

SearchDomain.description: combustion (default) excludes non-combustion sources such as FF-PSI-DSI (DAY2_TASKS domain filter rule). all disables that filter.

RetrievalMode.description: lexical: Postgres full-text only (available first). hybrid: lexical + pgvector dense ranks fused. Scores are only comparable within one mode.

GravityRegime.description: Gravity regime as reported by the source; `unknown` when the source does not state it.

test_id.description: Test identifier as written in the source table, e.g. `B1`.

result_id.description: Stable ID of the hit (chunk ID for passages, experiment ID for experiments). Unique within one response.

score.description: Relevance score from the retriever. Ordinal only; not a probability and not a confidence.

title.description: Document title or experiment display name.

snippet.description: Plain-text excerpt (no HTML). Verbatim from the source for document hits.

document_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

experiment_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

evidence_id.description: Evidence record that backs this hit. Resolve with GET /api/evidence/{evidence_id}.

ingested_at.description: When the underlying record was ingested/published.

SearchFilters.description: Echo of the filters the server actually applied, after defaults.

index_version.description: Vector index version; null in lexical mode.

searched_but_empty.description: True when the corpus was searched and nothing relevant was found (render as an honest empty state, not an error).

stack_version.description: Version of the ai/rag search stack that ordered the results (ADR-006), e.g. `flame-search-2.0.0`.

TextLayer.description: Whether the original PDF has an extractable text layer. partial: some pages need OCR (see pages_without_text).

document_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

identifier.description: Report number or upstream identifier, e.g. `NASA/TM-2000-209773` or NTRS `20000034017`.

persistent_identifier.description: Document-level DOI when the document has its own.

pages_without_text.description: Pages flagged for OCR; their text is not searchable yet.

items.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

experiment_ids.description: Experiments this document is linked to.

evidence_count.description: Evidence records whose target is this document.

ConditionOrigin.description: reported: value as written in the source. derived: computed by us (e.g. unit conversion); `value_si` is always derived.

variable.description: Condition name from the data dictionary, e.g. `o2_fraction`, `flow_velocity`.

value_numeric.description: Original numeric value. Null when missing or non-numeric — never 0 for missing.

value_text.description: Original textual value when not numeric.

evidence_id.description: Evidence record pointing at the source table row.

experiment_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

items.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

EvidenceOrigin.description: source_evidence: content that exists in an upstream NASA/NIST artefact. calculated_measurement: a deterministic, reproducible computation by a versioned Flame pipeline. Model-generated interpretation and inference are NEVER evidence.

ExtractionMethod.description: How the evidence content was obtained.

ReviewStatus.description: Review state (data dictionary: review_status). The UI must visibly distinguish human_verified and must not render rejected evidence as support.

evidence_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

citation.description: Formatted human-readable citation assembled from stored fields only.

document_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

experiment_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

analysis_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

anyOf.description: The original (or derived) file the locator applies to.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote from the original at the locator. Null for purely numeric evidence.

extraction_confidence.description: Only when the extraction method itself produced one (e.g. OCR). Null otherwise — never synthesised.

transformation_id.description: Parser/pipeline version that produced this record.

AnalysisStatus.description: Terminal states: completed, failed, cancelled. `cancelled` is set by the server: by `POST /api/analyses/{analysis_id}/cancel` (contract 0.6.0), or by job recovery when a stuck job had a cancel request.

AnalysisType.description: flame_image: one PNG/JPEG image. flame_video (0.3.0, ADR-005): an MP4/MOV/AVI video analysed on sampled frames with a temporal summary.

ArtifactKind.description: original: the uploaded bytes, immutable. preprocessed: oriented/colour-converted input to the model. mask: binary flame mask (PNG, original resolution). overlay: original with mask contour drawn (PNG).

url.description: API-relative URL to fetch the bytes: /api/analyses/{analysis_id}/artifacts/{kind}. Never a raw object-storage URL.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

CalibrationState.description: absent: measurements are pixels only. spatial_scale_provided: caller supplied px-per-mm, enabling ESTIMATED physical lengths/areas. No radiometric calibration state exists in v0.1, so temperature is never produced.

scale_source.description: How the scale was established, as supplied by the caller.

image_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact uploaded bytes (the video file for flame_video; the field name predates video).

media_type.description: Media type detected from content (not from the filename or client header). Video types only for flame_video.

experiment_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

source_file_id.description: files.jsonl file_id the image was taken from, when it comes from the corpus.

video.description: Probe metadata and sampling policy; present only for flame_video (0.3.0).

camera_profile.description: The camera_profile the analysis was requested with, or null. Absent on analyses created before it was added.

artifact_digest.description: Digest of the model weights/package; null for non-learned (classical) stages.

pipeline_version.description: Version of the whole CV pipeline, e.g. `cv-0.1.0`.

measurement_space.description: All pixel coordinates and measurements are in the original image's pixel grid after EXIF orientation, regardless of any internal resize.

execution.description: Which vision provider ran (flame_cv or hf_space) (0.2.0).

BoundingBox.description: Axis-aligned box in measurement_space pixels (origin top-left).

confidence.description: Detector score. Null for classical (threshold) detectors that produce no calibrated score. The single place detection confidence lives.

threshold_policy.description: How the mask was produced, e.g. `otsu-v1` or `prob>=0.5`.

component_count.description: Connected flame components in the mask.

confidence.description: Segmenter score; null when the method produces none.

contours.description: Outer boundary polygon(s) of each component, simplified to `simplification_tolerance_px`. For client-side overlay toggling.

MeasurementClass.description: measured: computed from validated pixels with a stated method and pixel units. estimated: depends on an assumption/calibration (e.g. caller-supplied scale) and carries uncertainty.

value.description: Null when not computable for this image (e.g. no flame detected).

uncertainty.description: Absolute uncertainty in `unit`, when the method provides one. Never invented.

GeometryPx.description: Image-plane geometry in pixels. Always present for completed analyses (values null when no flame).

GeometryPhysical.description: Projected physical size from the caller-supplied spatial scale. A 2-D projection: not a 3-D flame dimension.

mean_r.description: Mean red channel inside the mask, unit intensity_8bit.

mean_intensity.description: Mean luma inside the mask, unit intensity_8bit.

saturated_fraction.description: Fraction of mask pixels at sensor maximum in any channel, unit fraction.

physical_interpretation.description: Constant. Image-derived colour/intensity statistics are not physical state variables; in particular they are NOT temperature (MVP plan §10).

calibration_absent.description: Radiometric calibration absent. Always true in v0.1.

QualityFlags.description: Image-quality flags (MVP plan §10). Null = the check is not implemented / was not evaluated, which is different from false.

ClaimClass.description: Scientific interpretation label (MVP plan §10). cv_pipeline statements are observed/measured/estimated only; aura_interpretation statements are inferred/hypothesized/unsupported only.

StatementOrigin.description: cv_pipeline: deterministic template text generated from measurements. aura_interpretation: model-generated text, validated by Flame before storage. model_interpretation: the same, written by a non-AURA model chosen by Flame's router.

items.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

evidence_ids.description: Flame evidence IDs supporting the statement. Every ID is verified to exist before the statement is stored; `unsupported` statements have none.

observations.description: Deterministic statements derived from the measurements.

InterpretationStatus.description: unavailable: AURA disabled or unreachable; the analysis itself still completes.

provider.description: Router provider that produced the statements (e.g. aura, ollama, vllm). Null until generated.

model.description: Model identifier reported by the provider.

rejected_statement_count.description: Statements dropped by Flame validation (unknown evidence IDs, disallowed claim class, temperature claims).

Interpretation.description: Optional AI interpretation. Never alters measurements; displayed separately from them.

severity.description: info: context the user should see; warning: affects how results may be used.

AnalysisFailureCode.description: Why a job ended in failed/cancelled. A no-flame image is NOT a failure: it completes with detection.status = absent.

analysis_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

cancel_requested_at.description: When a cancel was requested for a running job (contract 0.6.0). Absent when none was requested. The job stops at its next checkpoint (video) or before storing its result (image), then status becomes `cancelled`.

artifacts.description: `original` is present from creation; the others appear when status = completed.

anyOf.description: Non-null iff status is failed or cancelled.

poll_after_ms.description: Suggested delay before the next GET while non-terminal; null when terminal.

progress.description: Video jobs only (contract 0.6.0); absent for image analyses.

analysis_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

image_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

experiment_id.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

overlay_url.description: Overlay artifact URL when completed with a flame; use as thumbnail.

image.description: PNG or JPEG, ≤ 10 MiB, ≥ 64×64 px, ≤ 50 megapixels. Type is detected from the bytes. Send exactly one of image or video.

experiment_id.description: Link the image to an existing experiment. Unknown ID → 422 UNKNOWN_EXPERIMENT.

source_file_id.description: File identifier as recorded in datasets/metadata/files.jsonl (`sha256:` + first 16 hex chars).

scale_source.description: How the scale was obtained (e.g. ruler in frame, documented camera geometry).

request_interpretation.description: Ask for an AURA interpretation after measurements complete. Ignored (status unavailable + warning) when AURA is disabled.

video.description: MP4/MOV/AVI (detected from the bytes), H.264/H.265, ≤ 200 MiB (FLAME_MAX_VIDEO_UPLOAD_BYTES), ≤ 600 s. Creates a flame_video analysis (0.3.0). Calibration fields are rejected for video.

sample_every_n_frames.description: Video only: analyse every N-th frame.

max_frames.description: Video only: cap on sampled frames (≤ FLAME_MAX_VIDEO_FRAMES, default 600).

camera_profile.description: Optional fixed-camera profile from `cv/configs/camera_profiles.json` (e.g. `flex-colour`). Its exclusion zones (static bright hardware in that camera's view) are removed before detection; the zones used are reported in the CV result's preprocessing. An unknown name is a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

ExecutionMode.description: Hybrid AI execution mode (Sub-phase 2H). offline_only never contacts an external provider.

ExecutionMetadata.description: Which provider and model produced a result, and why the router chose it.

RoutingFailure.description: Why no model could serve the request (degraded mode).

permitted.description: False when the current mode blocks it (external provider in offline_only).

env_mode.description: FLAME_AI_EXECUTION_MODE as configured; can differ from `mode` only under an audit override.

decisions.description: Routing decision counters keyed `task|provider|outcome`, since process start.

env_mode.description: FLAME_AI_EXECUTION_MODE as configured; can differ from `mode` only under an audit override.

execution.description: ExecutionMetadata when a model answered; RoutingFailure when none could (warning generation_unavailable); null when no evidence matched.

codec.description: FourCC reported by the decoder, e.g. avc1.

fps.description: Constant frame rate used for timestamps (VFR streams are resampled; see variable_frame_rate).

VideoInput.description: Video metadata probed synchronously at upload (cv/video_ingestion.py probe_video).

pixel_area.description: Flame mask area in px² (measured). Null when absent or the frame failed.

error_code.description: CV error for this frame; the frame is then reported as uncertain.

persistence_rate.description: Fraction of sampled frames with a detected flame.

flicker_frequency_hz.description: Dominant area oscillation; null when not estimable (see flicker_note). Limited by the sampling rate (Nyquist).

tracking_stability_px2.description: Mean rolling centroid variance in px². Null when not estimable (see tracking_note).

track_sessions.description: Null when the sampling interval exceeds the tracking gap (see tracking_note).

classification.description: Deterministic statistics over per-frame pixel measurements; no physical units.

tracking_note.description: Why tracking metrics are null, e.g. sampled frames are further apart than the 0.5 s tracking gap.

VideoTemporalSummary.description: Thresholds and configuration are in docs/cv/temporal-analysis.md.

frames.description: Sampled frames in time order; temporal order is preserved.

FlameVideoAnalysisResult.description: Result of a flame_video analysis (0.3.0). Pixel units only; no temperature. `audio` (0.7.0) is present only when the deployment runs with FLAME_TRANSCRIPTION_ENABLED=true.

start_s.description: Seconds from the start of the audio track. Approximate to a few seconds: voice-activity detection merges speech into long chunks.

text.description: Machine speech-to-text. Untrusted text; words can be wrong.

avg_logprob.description: Whisper's average token log-probability for the chunk the segment belongs to; closer to 0 is more confident.

no_speech_prob.description: Whisper's probability that the chunk is not speech; high values suggest noise.

status.description: `silent` means the track exists but its loudest second is at or below -55 dBFS, so no model was run. `unavailable` means transcription could not run (see `failure_code`); the video analysis itself is unaffected.

loudest_second_dbfs.description: RMS level of the loudest one-second window of the audio track, in dBFS.

classification.description: Never `measured` and never evidence: this is machine speech-to-text of operator audio.

note.description: The caveat to show next to the text.

failure_code.description: Set when status is `unavailable`: a provider error code such as `model_missing`, or `decode_failed`, `no_provider`, `transcription_failed`.

execution.description: Which local provider produced the transcript; null when none ran.

VideoAudioTranscript.description: Operator speech from a flame_video analysis's audio track (0.7.0). Context only: not measurement, not evidence, and not used by AI interpretation.

FileStatus.description: file_record.status (M9). A quarantined file is kept for review but never parsed or indexed.

file_id.description: File identifier as recorded in datasets/metadata/files.jsonl (`sha256:` + first 16 hex chars).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes.

canonical_source_url.description: Where the original was fetched from (s3:// or PSI API URL).

is_original.description: True for an immutable upstream original; false for a derived artefact.

parent_file_id.description: file_id of the original this artefact was derived from.

quarantine_reason.description: Why ingestion quarantined the file (e.g. checksum_mismatch, unreadable_pdf, encrypted_pdf); null when active.

AdminFile.description: A file_record as administrators see it: FileRef plus its source, status and quarantine reason. Admin only.

transformation_id.description: Parser version that produced the rows, or `quarantine` for a failed run.

counts.description: Per-run counts, or `{reason}` for a quarantine run.

IngestionRun.description: One ingestion_run row (lineage of what parsed which file bytes).

actor.description: `write-token` until per-user admin identities exist (ADR-009 step 2).

before.description: Values before the change; applying them is the rollback.

after.description: Values after the change, plus the administrator's `note` if one was given.

note.description: Free-text reason, kept in the audit event's `after.note`.

AdminReviewStatus.description: The ReviewStatus values an administrator may set (`raw` is never a review outcome).

note.description: Free-text reason, kept in the audit event's `after.note`.

previous_review_status.description: Null when the row never had a review_status.

AiModeSource.description: Where the effective `mode` comes from: `env` is FLAME_AI_EXECUTION_MODE; `audit_override` is the newest `ai.mode.changed` audit event (PUT /api/admin/ai/mode), which wins over env in every process until the next PUT. There is no clear operation yet.

Scenario.description: A cabin atmosphere. Quoted or derived values cite NASA/TM-2008-215260 p. 5; `historical` scenarios (contract 0.7.0, ADR-013) are past atmospheres with a cited story at `GET /api/scenarios/{scenario_id}/history`; `user` is a custom query. `gravity` is the gravity the atmosphere exists in: every flight test in this corpus is microgravity, so any other value is outside the flight data.

InvestigationData.description: What the investigation's published table covers. A null range means the variable is not recorded in the table (never 0).

Relevance.description: Evidence relevance of an investigation to a scenario (not a risk score); formula in `ranking_method`.

CitedText.description: NASA ISA-Tab metadata text, verbatim, with the evidence row it came from.

rank.description: Position in the scenario ranking (list endpoint only); null when the investigation has no ingested data.

InsightKind.description: measured_statistic: computed from flight-test rows. model_estimate: from the FLEX outcome model (claim class estimated). coverage_gap: what the data does not cover.

FlexOutcomeResponse.description: FLEX outcome model estimate (claim class `estimated`). `probabilities` is null outside the applicability domain.

SummarySection.description: One ISA-Tab section (Objective, Hypothesis, Approach, Research impacts), verbatim, with its evidence row.

AnalysisProgress.description: Video jobs only (ADR-008): sampled frames measured and stored in the job's checkpoint so far. Updated once per checkpoint segment (`FLAME_VIDEO_CHECKPOINT_EVERY_FRAMES`, default 10), not per frame.

frames_total.description: Sampled frames this job will measure.

QueryRewrite.description: The rule-based rewrite kept next to the original query (ADR-006, `ai/rag/query/rewrite.py`): whitespace normalisation and expansion of known abbreviations (ISS, PSI, NTRS), appended in parentheses. Lexical search uses the original query; semantic search embeds the rewritten one.

changed.description: False when the rewrite equals the query.

RerankingInfo.description: What reranking did (ADR-006). `disabled`: FLAME_RERANKER_ENABLED is false and the order is RRF only. `applied`: a cross-encoder, reached through the model router, reordered the first `depth` fused results (they take over the window's fused scores in their new order, so `score` stays monotonic with `rank`). `unavailable`: reranking was configured but failed, so the RRF order is returned; the search does not fail.

depth.description: Size of the reranked window, counted from the first result of page 1.

GraphEntityType.description: E2-6 entity types. `fuel` covers fuels and solid materials, as written in the source tables. `platform` and `instrument` come only from NLP extraction (`extraction_method` `nlp_extraction`, always unreviewed until a person reviews them).

display_name.description: The spelling the source first used.

aliases.description: Other spellings resolved to this entity, including merged entities' names.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence that identifies the entity itself (e.g. the test-ID cell).

merged_into.description: Set on an entity merged into another; listings omit merged entities.

depth.description: Hops from the requested entity (neighbourhood only).

relation_count.description: Non-rejected relations touching the entity (listing only).

evidence_id.description: The evidence row the edge was read from; resolves at `GET /api/evidence/{evidence_id}`. Null only for `manual` edges.

entities.description: The requested entity and the endpoints of the returned edges, nearest first.

edges.description: Edges among reachable entities, nearest first, at most `max_edges`.

truncated.description: True when more edges were reachable than `max_edges`.

reachable_entities.description: Every entity within `depth` hops, including the requested one, before truncation.

resolved_from.description: The requested ID when it was merged into `entity` (old IDs keep resolving); null otherwise.

blocking.description: A blocking check with a non-zero count makes `ok` false; a non-blocking one lists candidates for human review.

Coverage.description: Scenario-level verdict (contract 0.7.0, ADR-013): does any flight test speak to this atmosphere? The relevance score of each investigation can stay above zero for an atmosphere nobody flew, so the dashboard shows this verdict, the nearest real test and the gap before the ranking. `none` when the scenario's gravity was never flown or no test lies within ±0.03 O2 (and ±25% pressure when recorded); `partial` when 1–4 such tests exist, the atmosphere is outside the flown O2 or pressure range, or fewer than 5 of those tests record a pressure within ±25% (a test with no recorded pressure, such as BASS-II or SAFFIRE, cannot show the scenario's pressure was flown); otherwise `covered`.

evidence.description: Evidence IDs of the O2 (and pressure) cells.

CitedSource.description: An NTRS report page. `evidence_id` is the ingested page (null until the report is ingested).

ScenarioHistoryResponse.description: A historical scenario (contract 0.7.0): its cited story, timeline and the data-covered alternative to show after the refusal. Every statement carries NTRS pages.

flex_estimate.description: FLEX outcome model for CO₂ (claim class estimated) with nearest flight tests. Null for water mist and for non-FLEX fire types.

thermal_estimate.description: Thermal (effective-enthalpy) model, claim class computed. Null when withheld.

withheld.description: Why a number is not shown.

SuppressionAdviceResponse.description: Suppression Advisor output. outcome is recommend, no_clear_winner or no_recommendation; recommended_agent is null unless outcome is recommend.

co2_idlh_volume_m3.description: Cabin volume below which one CO₂ PFE, well mixed, reaches the CO₂ IDLH.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-ID
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional client-generated correlation ID (≤ 128 chars, [A-Za-z0-9._-]). Echoed in the response header and in meta/error.request_id.

schema.description: ULID (MVP plan §9 / DAY2_TASKS: ULID primary keys).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying or polling.

ETag.description: Quoted SHA-256 of the artifact bytes.

BadRequest.description: Malformed or invalid parameters. Codes: VALIDATION_ERROR.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API bearer token. Code: AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted. Codes: FORBIDDEN.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests from this client for this kind of operation (reads, writes and chat each have a per-minute budget). Codes: RATE_LIMITED. `Retry-After` is the wait in seconds; `error.details` carries `limit_per_minute` and `retry_after_s`.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error; no internals are exposed. Codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

bearerAuth.description: Required. A per-client API key (`flk_…`) with the `read` scope for GET/HEAD and `POST /api/chat`, the `write` scope for other mutations, or the `admin` scope for `/api/admin/*`. Deprecated but accepted: FLAME_READ_API_TOKEN for reads and the distinct FLAME_WRITE_API_TOKEN for mutations and admin operations.
